from.description: The list that the index counts in: input, the input parameters, or result, the returns that are values or streams.

index.description: The position in the list, from 0.

bindings.description: The positions of the callable that fill the parts of the shape, by the name of the part.

claim.description: The assertion of the classification, in neutral vocabulary.

counterexamples.description: The inputs that a check covers.

edge.description: An input at a boundary of the claim.

invalid.description: An input that the subject refuses.

refused.description: A callable or a use that the classification excludes.

unsafe.description: An input that does not pass through the subject unchanged.

detected.description: When true, a detector classifies callables as the shape.

falsifiability.description: What turns red when someone deletes the subject's handling.

form.description: The form of the spec, shape.

name.description: The name of the shape, in lowercase words joined by hyphens.

observation.description: What a check observes to check the claim.

params.description: The params of the shape's variant of the shape directive.

also_on.description: The callable params of the spec whose callables also declare the parameter that this host-param reference refers to.

counterexample.description: When true, the value is an input that no derivation could invent.

excludes.description: The params of the spec that an instance does not write beside this one.

key.description: The key of the param in the directive, in lowercase words joined by hyphens.

minimum.description: The least value of an int param.

required.description: When true, an instance of the directive writes the param.

resolve.description: The kind of declaration that a reference refers to. A reference requires it.

roles.description: The roles of a contract under which the param applies.

type.description: The type of the value: string, int or reference.

precedence.description: The detected shapes that rank before this one.

yields_to.description: The detected shapes that rank before this one.
